mapping.summary: Runs several divisions or legal entities inside one BC company with segregated data.
claims: Business Groups separate customers, vendors, items, locations and banking within one company
VAT Groups link to Business Units for VAT reporting and settlement
Groups are tied to shortcut dimensions for filtering and posting
Per-user access to groups with a default level for unassigned users
Sales, purchase and finance documents are linked to a group
Recharges between groups create matching sales and purchase invoices
Each group has its own address and bank details on printed documents
G/L and VAT registers gain group columns and filters
Aged payables and receivables filter by group
Close income statement, VAT settlement, vendor payment suggestions and depreciation per group
Guided setup for dimensions, VAT Groups and Business Groups
